effects.effect: Your focus on your fragmentary visions grants divine insight into the world and its creatures beyond your usual senses. Whenever you would make an [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition) [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test), you can make a [Presence](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/presence) [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) instead.
